[ASSISTANT_SAID] Apples are portable, easy to eat, and rich in fiber and antioxidants.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bananas come in their own natural packaging and are a great source of potassium, vitamin C, and dietary fiber.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Grapes require minimal preparation and are a natural source of antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Berries, such as strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries, are nutrient-dense and packed with vitamins and antioxidants.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dried fruits like apricots, raisins, or dates have a longer shelf life and can be calorie-dense; unsweetened varieties are recommended.
